title: [Exploring active components and targets of Gentiana straminea in treating rheumatoid arthritis based on serum pharmacochemistry and network pharmacology].
authors: Zhai, Ke-Xin; Li, Ya-Nan; Ding, Jia-Li; Wang, Min; Zhuang, Yuan-Wen; Lin, Peng-Cheng; Xia, Gui-Yang; Lin, Sheng
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文用血清药化、网络药理学和分子对接研究龙胆抗类风湿关节炎的活性成分与靶点，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分可借鉴其分子对接思路，故评分较低。
abstract: This study aims to meet the therapeutic needs of rheumatoid arthritis(RA) by focusing on the traditional anti-arthritic medicinal plant Gentiana straminea. An integrated strategy combining characterization of absorbed components, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular interaction verification was employed to systematically investigate the pharmacodynamic material basis and mechanism of this herb against RA. Ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole-time of flight-tandem mass spectrometry(UHPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS) was performed, which identified gentiopicroside, swertiamarin, and loganic acid as the core components absorbed into blood. Network pharmacology prediction and target mapping revealed that these components were primarily involved in RA-related biological processes such as inflammatory response and immune cell activation. Molecular docking suggested that the core components exhibited favorable binding potential with key targets including STAT3, EGFR, and MMP9. Further quantitative validation with bio-layer interferometry demonstrated that gentiopicroside(KD=50.1 nmol.L~(-1)) and swertiamarin(KD=87.7 nmol.L~(-1)) specifically bound to STAT3 with high affinity. The results indicate that G. straminea exert anti-RA effects through its iridoids by targeting STAT3 and modulating related inflammatory pathways, providing a scientific basis for the clinical application of G. straminea and the development of natural anti-RA drugs.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过关注传统抗关节炎药用植物麻花秦艽（Gentiana straminea），满足类风湿关节炎（RA）的治疗需求。采用整合策略，结合吸收成分表征、网络药理学、分子对接及分子相互作用验证，系统研究该草药抗RA的药效物质基础及作用机制。通过超高效液相色谱-四极杆-飞行时间-串联质谱（UHPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS）分析，鉴定出龙胆苦苷（gentiopicroside）、獐牙菜苦苷（swertiamarin）和马钱苷酸（loganic acid）为吸收入血的核心成分。网络药理学预测及靶点映射显示，这些成分主要参与炎症反应和免疫细胞活化等RA相关生物过程。分子对接提示，核心成分与STAT3、EGFR和MMP9等关键靶点表现出良好的结合潜力。进一步的生物层干涉定量验证表明，龙胆苦苷（KD=50.1 nmol·L⁻¹）和獐牙菜苦苷（KD=87.7 nmol·L⁻¹）以高亲和力特异性结合STAT3。结果表明，麻花秦艽通过其环烯醚萜类成分靶向STAT3并调节相关炎症通路发挥抗RA作用，为麻花秦艽的临床应用及天然抗RA药物的开发提供了科学依据。
